audit.sql: SELECT cd.category AS category, COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'comment' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'play' THEN 1 END), 0) AS comment_rate FROM user_behavior_fact ubf JOIN content_dim cd ON ubf.content_id = cd.content_id WHERE ubf.timestamp BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY cd.category
